lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Prepare unsent local layer data, trigger schema rebuild or Collector removal, simulate backup failure
Sync twice a layer whose server features have attachments but whose bytes were never downloaded to the device
Manually delete an editable layer that has server-only attachment metadata plus one attachment collected on this device
value.expected: Destructive mutation is cancelled and local layer data remains. Attachment metadata is available through FeatureAttachments after the first pull; the second pull creates no sync_remote_apply ZIP and does not download attachment bytes merely for backup. Manual layer deletion creates its backup without network access: tables retain all attachment metadata, the ZIP contains only the locally collected attachment bytes, and deletion completes without a crash.
